subject: RFQ & Commercial Discussion: Precision CNC Machined Aluminium Mounting Bracket (Housing Mount) [Qty: 5000]
body:
Dear Bhavin Goswami,

We are evaluating suppliers for the procurement of 5000 units of Precision CNC Machined Aluminium Mounting Bracket (Housing Mount) for our Vadodara manufacturing facility.

Reviewing Sanand Auto Machining Cluster Co's manufacturing capabilities and quality certifications, we would like to invite your formal quotation. Based on our volume commitment of 5000 pieces and scheduled delivery within 30 days, our target price is INR 461.00 per piece under standard Net 30 payment terms.

Please confirm manufacturing feasibility against our drawing specifications and your earliest delivery schedule.

Sincerely,
Procurement Lead, Gujarat Precision Electro-Mech Pvt. Ltd.
